subject: angol
title: Your school and your studies
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató az iskoládról, a tantárgyakról, az iskolai hagyományokról és a nyelvtanulásról kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: What's the name of your school, and how long have you been a student there?
How do you get to school, and how long does it take?
What is your favourite subject? Why?
followUps: Which subject do you find the most difficult?

questions.q: What does a typical school day look like for you?
Can you tell me about a school tradition or event that you enjoy?
followUps: What did you do at the last one?

questions.q: Why are you learning English? How long have you been learning it?
Apart from English, would you like to learn another language? Which one?
What do you usually do after school?
What would you like to do after you finish secondary school?

usefulPhrases.en: I'm in my last year of secondary school.
We get a lot of homework.
I'd like to go to university.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What's the name of your school, and how long have you been a student there?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I go to the Bolyai János Gimnázium in Kecskemét. I've been a student there for nearly four years, and next spring I'm going to take my final exams.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What is your favourite subject? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My favourite subject is history, because our teacher tells us lots of interesting stories, so the lessons are never boring. I'm also interested in how people lived in the past.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which subject do you find the most difficult?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Definitely physics. I understand the theory, but I often make mistakes when I have to solve problems.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Can you tell me about a school tradition or event that you enjoy?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My favourite one is the szalagavató, a ball for the final-year students. Our class performed a waltz that we had practised for months, and our parents were really proud of us.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Why are you learning English? How long have you been learning it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I've been learning English since I was eight. I think it's really useful, because I'd like to travel a lot, and I also watch films in English without subtitles.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What would you like to do after you finish secondary school?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd like to study to become a primary school teacher in Szeged. I love working with children, so I think it would be the perfect job for me.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: minden válasz tartalmas, a vizsgázó indokol (because our teacher tells us …) és konkrét példát hoz (a szalagavató keringője), a magyar fogalmat pedig röviden angolul is elmagyarázza.
Szókincs: az iskolai élet szavai pontosak és a témához illők (final exams, solve problems, final-year students, subtitles, primary school teacher).

Nyelvhelyesség: a befejezett jelen idő a „for” és a „since” szóval hibátlan (I've been a student there for nearly four years; I've been learning English since I was eight), a jövőbeli tervet pedig a „going to” és az „I'd like to” fejezi ki.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I've been learning English since I was eight”, „Definitely physics.”, „that we had practised for months”, „it would be the perfect job for me”.
